title: writers
explanation:
### Description

Test image writers by reading TIFF, writing in multiple formats, and displaying luminance.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkBMPWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBMPWriter.html) — bmp writer.
- [vtkImageActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageActor.html) — image actor.
- [vtkImageLuminance](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageLuminance.html) — image luminance.
- [vtkJPEGWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkJPEGWriter.html) — jpeg writer.
- [vtkPNGWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNGWriter.html) — png writer.
- [vtkPNMWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNMWriter.html) — pnm writer.
- [vtkPostScriptWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPostScriptWriter.html) — post script writer.
- [vtkTIFFReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFReader.html) — reads TIFF image files.
- [vtkTIFFWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFWriter.html) — tiff writer.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
